author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Zoom Phone's phone system operation logs and the account's call history, polled from the Zoom Phone API by the example bridge in bridges/zoom-report-logs (set ZOOM_REPORTS to phone_operationlogs,phone_call_history) and posted to HTTP Ingest. Use a Server-to-Server OAuth app with only phone:read:operation_logs:admin and phone:read:list_call_logs:admin. Operation logs need a Pro plan or higher and a Zoom Phone plan; call history needs a Business or Enterprise account. The bridge puts "zoom_record" first (phone_operation or phone_call) and adds account_id. Operation logs go to CloudAudit with the action as the event name, the category as the event type and the operator as the user; operation_detail is free text, so it goes to the additional data. Calls fit no schema, so they stay in Generic through the parent, with the call history ID as the event ID and the call's start as the event time; direction, the international flag, numbers, countries, result and spam stay in the original data. Zoom documents the operation log fields with one example (Phone Number, ADD, "Add BYOC" and a number); the other categories, actions and details in the samples are made up in that shape. Call samples follow the call history response in Zoom's reference with made-up values. The child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-22 (58 of 58 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same records there. The child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (46 of 46 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs), and the parent alone matched every call record. No built-in parser claimed these records in 3 runs.
